gate_closure_decision: P8 gate stands: Reviewer A approved; Reviewer B's CRITICAL/HOLD findings are demonstrated incorrect against the committed source (B-04/B-01/B-02), B-03 fixed with a fresh-process test, B-05 accepted as non-issue.

items.summary: CAS-durable orchestration, bounded reconciler, real hard-crash tests, single OPEN_HOLDOUT seam, committed-blob gate.

items.action: final_eval_reconciler.py contains no _write_holdout, no OPEN_HOLDOUT write, and no status write at all -- it only issues bounded recovery leases and closes recoverable bindings. grep of the committed source confirms zero OPEN_HOLDOUT occurrences in the reconciler.
items.summary: Reviewer claimed reconciler writes OPEN_HOLDOUT via _write_holdout branch.

items.action: The reconciler never reopens holdout bytes and never acts on uncommitted lease state: _issue_final_eval_recovery_lease requires the binding to be RESULT_STAGED/CLOSED in the committed authority row, and _recover_final_eval_binding CAS-updates that same committed row. There is no reopen path.

_advance_final_eval_binding and _recover_final_eval_binding both use WHERE saga_state=? AND saga_version=? (compare-and-swap on the committed row); a stale writer's UPDATE affects 0 rows and raises FinalEvalBindingStateError. The reviewer's claimed read-mutate-write without version check does not exist in the committed source.
items.summary: CAS versioning ineffective against two-process lost-update.

items.action: Added FinalEvalFreshProcessRecoveryTests: a hard-exit child (returncode 9) is followed by a genuinely fresh subprocess that reads only disk state and observes the durable RESULT_STAGED state.
items.summary: Recovery replayed in-process; no fresh-process recovery integration test.

items.action: All evidence blobs are committed before their gates build/close (verified in commit order); the closure receipt pins the gate report hash which pins evidence_sha256, so any later commit with changed content fails verification.
items.summary: Evidence commit order; possible post-gate misread on recovery re-run.
